title: Special floor area ratio provisions for certain areas

blocks.html: The floor area ratio provisions of Section 24-11 (Maximum Floor Area Ratio and Percentage of Lot Coverage), inclusive, shall be modified for certain areas as follows:
blocks.plainText: The floor area ratio provisions of Section 24-11 (Maximum Floor Area Ratio and Percentage of Lot Coverage), inclusive, shall be modified for certain areas as follows:

blocks.html: (a)        in R8B Districts within Community District 8, in the Borough of Manhattan, the maximum floor area ratio on a zoning lot containing community facility uses exclusively shall be 5.10;
blocks.plainText: (a) in R8B Districts within Community District 8, in the Borough of Manhattan, the maximum floor area ratio on a zoning lot containing community facility uses exclusively shall be 5.10;

blocks.html: (b)        in R10 Districts, except R10A or R10X Districts, within Community District 7, in the Borough of Manhattan, all zoning lots shall be limited to a maximum floor area ratio of 10.0; and
blocks.plainText: (b) in R10 Districts, except R10A or R10X Districts, within Community District 7, in the Borough of Manhattan, all zoning lots shall be limited to a maximum floor area ratio of 10.0; and

blocks.html: (c)        in R9 and R10 Districts, for zoning lots containing a building that is developed or enlarged pursuant to the applicable tower regulations of Sections 23-435 or 23-737 (Tower regulations), the provisions of Section 23-242 (Special provisions for certain community districts) shall apply:
blocks.plainText: (c) in R9 and R10 Districts, for zoning lots containing a building that is developed or enlarged pursuant to the applicable tower regulations of Sections 23-435 or 23-737 (Tower regulations), the provisions of Section 23-242 (Special provisions for certain community districts) shall apply:

blocks.html: (1)        to only the residential portion of a building where less than 75 percent of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use; and
blocks.plainText: (1) to only the residential portion of a building where less than 75 percent of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use; and

blocks.html: (2)        to the entire building where 75 percent or more of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use.
blocks.plainText: (2) to the entire building where 75 percent or more of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use.

chapter.title: Bulk Regulations for Community Facilities in Residence Districts

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) in R8B Districts within Community District 8, in the Borough of Manhattan, the maximum floor area ratio on a zoning lot containing community facility uses exclusively shall be 5.10;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) in R10 Districts, except R10A or R10X Districts, within Community District 7, in the Borough of Manhattan, all zoning lots shall be limited to a maximum floor area ratio of 10.0; and

subsections.label: (c)
subsections.plainText: (c) in R9 and R10 Districts, for zoning lots containing a building that is developed or enlarged pursuant to the applicable tower regulations of Sections 23-435 or 23-737 (Tower regulations), the provisions of Section 23-242 (Special provisions for certain community districts) shall apply:
(1) to only the residential portion of a building where less than 75 percent of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use; and
(2) to the entire building where 75 percent or more of the total floor area of such building is allocated to residential use.
